0.original: Nigen's brother should have returned from his errand by now.

24.original: Find Nigen's brother and slay any enemies that appear.

48.original: Hello there, adventurer. There is something I would ask of you if you have the time.

49.original: My brother spoke with the udgan for the first time today. The elder gods declared that he must collect his own weight in grass from the field to the southwest.

50.original: However, that field is home to many a deadly beast. I want nothing more than to check on his safety, but the gods have said I must cook our family's meals today.

51.original: My brother should still be gathering grass to the southwest. Please, go and check on him for me.

52.original: My brother should still be gathering grass to the southwest. Please, go and check on him for me.

53.original: Th-Thank you. I only let my guard down for a moment, but it was more than enough time for those creatures to attack.

54.original: You do not need to accompany me the rest of the way. It is time I proved myself strong enough to carry out what the gods ask of me on my own.

55.original: Did you find my brother? He is still yet to return.

56.original: Thank you for your help. My brother is returned at last.

57.original: We Mol consider the elder gods' orders to be absolute. We must follow them even if it means endangering our lives.

58.original: This is a small token of thanks from my brother and I.
